lina (DevEx): quick heads-up: hit a weird failure while running the sampleapp rerank flow locally. embeddings batch comes back with mixed dims after an auth refresh retry and rerank errors out.

sam (SDK Eng): whoa. any logs/snippets? how to repro? 

lina (DevEx): repro steps: start sampleapp, send embeddings batch of 5, throttle credentials so refresh happens mid-batch. sometimes one item arrives as 768d while the rest are 512d. rerank throws `inconsistent vector dimensions`. happens intermittently (~1 in 30).

noah (Backend): can you paste the minimal observed parsing output?

lina (DevEx): minimal printout: ```
shapes = [512, 512, 768, 512, 512]
# body fragment (pseudo)
response.items = [ [..512..], {vector: [..768..]}, [..512..] ]
```

sam (SDK Eng): interesting — two issues in one: (1) mixed dims, (2) inconsistent envelope (object vs raw array). Node client code expects arrays; py tolerated objects in main path but retry-merge assumes arrays. parity gap for sure.

noah (Backend): theory: on auth-refresh we re-dispatch requests and model routing can pick a different embedding model variant for one of the items. logs: request_id=abc123 -> model=open-embed-512-v1, then a retried item under same request_id picks open-embed-768-v2. that would explain the dim mismatch.

sam (SDK Eng): ok. short-term mitigation: add normalization in both SDKs when merging retry results: detect max dim in batch, pad with zeros and emit warning. I'll open a safeguard PR. Long-term: server must pin model_variant for the whole batch + request_id.

elaine (PM): is any customer impacted? do we need a support note?

lina (DevEx): saw one staging integration hit this and surface a 500 to the test suite. not yet production customer reports but risky.

sam (SDK Eng): plan: 1) PR with SDK normalization + unit tests that simulate auth retry with mixed shapes (will include both array and {vector:[]} envelope cases). 2) sampleapp CI rule: fail on any mixed dims. 3) add a small log metric whenever we coerce dims so DX can spot it.

ci-bot: Created PR #2244: "sdk: normalize embeddings when merging retry responses"

noah (Backend): I'll file BE-1178: pin model_variant across retries for a request_id and add extra debug logging to detect when mixing happens. also add an invariant assert in the merge path.

lina (DevEx): one more observation: retry path sometimes applies post-processing (quantize/reshape) differently depending on which backend worker handled the item. can you ensure postproc is consistent or moved to a single merge step?

noah (Backend): good call — we'll centralize postproc at merge time so retried + original items go through the exact same transformation pipeline.

sam (SDK Eng): I'll include a changelog blurb and update sampleapp README to note expected embedding dims and how SDK will handle coercion for now.

elaine (PM): timeline? we should coordinate a small note to support and include a short blurb in next release notes if we ship the SDK patch.

sam (SDK Eng): aiming to push the client patch within 3 hours, backend fix tracked for next sprint.

lina (DevEx): thanks. follow-ups: add a short troubleshooting snippet to onboarding docs showing how to trigger the CI check locally and a sample script to detect mixed-dim responses.

ci-bot: Linked PR #2244 to BE-1178 and created a test job: embed-dim-guard-canary.
